description: This source file implements functions related to the SEAMA firmware image format, including fixing MD5 checksums within SEAMA headers and updating such headers on MTD devices.

methods.name: int seama_fix_md5(struct seama_entity_header * shdr,int fd,size_t data_offset,size_t data_size)
methods.description: Updates the MD5 checksum and size in the SEAMA header after recalculating the MD5 over the entity data.

methods.name: int mtd_fixseama(const char * mtd,size_t offset,size_t data_size)
